Midterm 2, Practice Test: solutions

Worked solutions to all nine questions (26 points): the derivative rules, inverse trig and log derivatives, implicit and logarithmic differentiation, exponential growth, motion on a line, a related rate, linearization, and hyperbolic functions. Try each question on paper before you read its solution.
